I think the first point can be fixed by making it so whenever you downvote someone, you lose 1-2% of your CCP. This would kind of take away the ease at which people go through /v/all and downvote everything which they disagree with.

The second point can be fixed by requiring an email address to register an account. Of course, this opinion will be controversial (and i'm pretty sure people are going to downvote me for it), on privacy grounds. I think people can just make a fake email account just for the purpose of signing up. It wouldn't stop the voat-manipulators entirely, but it would slow them down a great deal. If I were to make 100 accounts, easy. But if I had to make 100 e-mail accounts, as well as 100 voat accounts, I wouldn't bother. Or at least someone would have to pay me twice the amount.
